---- MODULE Zab ----
EXTENDS ZabDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS

LOCAL AgentFinite == INSTANCE FiniteSetTheorems

AgentSafety ==
    /\ Leadership1
    /\ Leadership2
    /\ PrefixConsistency
    /\ Integrity
    /\ Agreement
    /\ TotalOrder
    /\ LocalPrimaryOrder
    /\ GlobalPrimaryOrder
    /\ PrimaryIntegrity

LEMMA AgentMinimumSingleton == \A n \in Int : Minimum({n}) = n
BY SMTT("r5") DEF Minimum

LEMMA AgentInitialSafety == Init => AgentSafety
<1>1. Init => Leadership1
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Leadership1, IsLeader,
                       LOOKING, LEADING
<1>2. Init => Leadership2
  <2>1. Cardinality({}) = 0
    BY AgentFinite!FS_EmptySet DEF AgentFinite!FS_EmptySet,
                                    AgentFinite!Cardinality, Cardinality
  <2> QED BY <2>1, SMTT("r10") DEF Init, InitVerifyVars, Leadership2
<1>3. Init => PrefixConsistency
  <2>1. Minimum({1, 1}) = 1
    BY SMTT("r5") DEF Minimum
  <2> QED BY <2>1, SMTT("r10")
     DEF Init, InitServerVars, PrefixConsistency, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
<1>4. Init => Integrity
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Integrity, IsFollower,
                       LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>5. Init => Agreement
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, Agreement, IsFollower,
                       LOOKING, FOLLOWING
<1>6. Init => TotalOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, TotalOrder
<1>7. Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, LocalPrimaryOrder
<1>8. Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>9. Init => PrimaryIntegrity
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Init, InitServerVars, PrimaryIntegrity, IsLeader,
                       LOOKING, LEADING
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9
     DEF AgentSafety

AgentCommitIndexType ==
  \A i \in Server : lastCommitted[i].index \in Nat

AgentAgreementInvariant == AgentCommitIndexType /\ PrefixConsistency

LEMMA AgentPairMinimum ==
  ASSUME NEW a \in Int, NEW b \in Int
  PROVE Minimum({a, b}) = IF a <= b THEN a ELSE b
<1>1. CASE a <= b
  BY SMTT("r10") DEF Minimum
<1>2. CASE ~(a <= b)
  BY SMTT("r10") DEF Minimum
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2

LEMMA AgentPrefixToAgreement ==
  AgentCommitIndexType /\ PrefixConsistency => Agreement
<1>1. ASSUME AgentCommitIndexType, PrefixConsistency,
             NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
             lastCommitted[i].index > 0,
             lastCommitted[j].index > 0,
             NEW x \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index,
             NEW y \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      PROVE \/ \E k \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index :
                 TxnEqual(history[j][k], history[i][x])
            \/ \E k \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index :
                 TxnEqual(history[i][k], history[j][y])
  <2>1. lastCommitted[i].index \in Int /\ lastCommitted[j].index \in Int
    BY <1>1, SMTT("r5") DEF AgentCommitIndexType
  <2>2. Minimum({lastCommitted[i].index, lastCommitted[j].index}) =
          IF lastCommitted[i].index <= lastCommitted[j].index
          THEN lastCommitted[i].index ELSE lastCommitted[j].index
    BY <2>1, AgentPairMinimum
  <2>3. CASE lastCommitted[i].index <= lastCommitted[j].index
    <3>1. x \in 1..lastCommitted[j].index
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>3, SMTT("r5")
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[j][x], history[i][x])
      BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>3, SMTT("r5") DEF PrefixConsistency, TxnEqual, ZxidEqual
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2>4. CASE ~(lastCommitted[i].index <= lastCommitted[j].index)
    <3>1. y \in 1..lastCommitted[i].index
      BY <1>1, <2>1, <2>4, SMTT("r5")
    <3>2. TxnEqual(history[i][y], history[j][y])
      BY <1>1, <2>2, <2>4, SMTT("r5") DEF PrefixConsistency
    <3> QED BY <3>1, <3>2
  <2> QED BY <2>3, <2>4
<1> QED BY <1>1 DEF Agreement


\* All transitions other than ACKEPOCH leave the historical leader log alone.
AgentOtherEpochSteps ==
    \/ \E i \in Server : UpdateLeader(i)
    \/ \E i \in Server : FollowLeader(i)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : Timeout(i, j)
    \/ \E i \in Server : Restart(i)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessCEPOCH(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessNEWLEADER(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACKLD(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessCOMMITLD(i, j)
    \/ \E i \in Server : LeaderProcessRequest(i)
    \/ \E i \in Server : LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE(i)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessPROPOSE(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : LeaderProcessACK(i, j)
    \/ \E i, j \in Server : FollowerProcessCOMMIT(i, j)

LEMMA AgentEpochLogFrame ==
  AgentOtherEpochSteps => UNCHANGED epochLeader
BY SMTT("r10") DEF AgentOtherEpochSteps, UpdateLeader, FollowLeader,
   Timeout, Restart, ConnectAndFollowerSendCEPOCH, LeaderProcessCEPOCH,
   FollowerProcessNEWEPOCH, FollowerProcessNEWLEADER, LeaderProcessACKLD,
   FollowerProcessCOMMITLD, LeaderProcessRequest, LeaderBroadcastPROPOSE,
   FollowerProcessPROPOSE, LeaderProcessACK, FollowerProcessCOMMIT, verifyVars

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership1
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership1.tla
<1>1. Init => Leadership1
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. Leadership1 /\ Next => Leadership1'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, Leadership1
<1>3. Leadership1 /\ UNCHANGED vars => Leadership1'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Leadership1, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. Leadership1 /\ [Next]_vars => Leadership1'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership1.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Leadership2
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership2.tla
<1>1. Init => Leadership2
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. Leadership2 /\ Next => Leadership2'
  <2>1. Leadership2 /\ AgentOtherEpochSteps => Leadership2'
    BY AgentEpochLogFrame, SMTT("r5") DEF Leadership2
  \* The remaining obligation requires an epoch-ownership invariant.
  <2>2. ASSUME Leadership2, NEW i \in Server, NEW j \in Server,
               LeaderProcessACKEPOCH(i, j)
        PROVE Leadership2'
    BY <2>2, SMTT("r5") DEF LeaderProcessACKEPOCH, Leadership2
  <2> QED BY <2>1, <2>2 DEF Next, AgentOtherEpochSteps
<1>3. Leadership2 /\ UNCHANGED vars => Leadership2'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Leadership2, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. Leadership2 /\ [Next]_vars => Leadership2'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Leadership2.tla

THEOREM Spec => []PrefixConsistency
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_PrefixConsistency.tla
<1>1. Init => PrefixConsistency
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. PrefixConsistency /\ Next => PrefixConsistency'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, PrefixConsistency
<1>3. PrefixConsistency /\ UNCHANGED vars => PrefixConsistency'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF PrefixConsistency, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. PrefixConsistency /\ [Next]_vars => PrefixConsistency'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_PrefixConsistency.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Integrity
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Integrity.tla
<1>1. Init => Integrity
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. Integrity /\ Next => Integrity'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, Integrity
<1>3. Integrity /\ UNCHANGED vars => Integrity'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Integrity, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. Integrity /\ [Next]_vars => Integrity'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Integrity.tla

THEOREM Spec => []Agreement
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Agreement.tla
<1>1. Init => AgentAgreementInvariant
  BY AgentInitialSafety, SMTT("r5")
     DEF AgentAgreementInvariant, AgentCommitIndexType, AgentSafety,
         Init, InitServerVars
\* Preservation needs invariants for the message and history contents.
<1>2. AgentAgreementInvariant /\ Next => AgentAgreementInvariant'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentAgreementInvariant, AgentCommitIndexType,
                       PrefixConsistency, Next
<1>3. AgentAgreementInvariant /\ UNCHANGED vars => AgentAgreementInvariant'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF AgentAgreementInvariant, AgentCommitIndexType,
                       PrefixConsistency, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars
<1>4. Spec => []AgentAgreementInvariant
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, PTL DEF Spec
<1>5. AgentAgreementInvariant => Agreement
  BY AgentPrefixToAgreement DEF AgentAgreementInvariant
<1> QED BY <1>4, <1>5, PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_Agreement.tla

THEOREM Spec => []TotalOrder
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_TotalOrder.tla
<1>1. Init => TotalOrder
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. TotalOrder /\ Next => TotalOrder'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, TotalOrder
<1>3. TotalOrder /\ UNCHANGED vars => TotalOrder'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF TotalOrder, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. TotalOrder /\ [Next]_vars => TotalOrder'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_TotalOrder.tla

THEOREM Spec => []LocalPrimaryOrder
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_LocalPrimaryOrder.tla
<1>1. Init => LocalPrimaryOrder
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. LocalPrimaryOrder /\ Next => LocalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, LocalPrimaryOrder
<1>3. LocalPrimaryOrder /\ UNCHANGED vars => LocalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF LocalPrimaryOrder, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. LocalPrimaryOrder /\ [Next]_vars => LocalPrimaryOrder'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_LocalPrimaryOrder.tla

THEOREM Spec => []GlobalPrimaryOrder
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_GlobalPrimaryOrder.tla
<1>1. Init => GlobalPrimaryOrder
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ Next => GlobalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, GlobalPrimaryOrder
<1>3. GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ UNCHANGED vars => GlobalPrimaryOrder'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF GlobalPrimaryOrder, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. GlobalPrimaryOrder /\ [Next]_vars => GlobalPrimaryOrder'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_GlobalPrimaryOrder.tla

THEOREM Spec => []PrimaryIntegrity
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_PrimaryIntegrity.tla
<1>1. Init => PrimaryIntegrity
  BY AgentInitialSafety DEF AgentSafety
<1>2. PrimaryIntegrity /\ Next => PrimaryIntegrity'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF Next, PrimaryIntegrity
<1>3. PrimaryIntegrity /\ UNCHANGED vars => PrimaryIntegrity'
  BY SMTT("r5") DEF PrimaryIntegrity, vars, serverVars, leaderVars,
                       followerVars, electionVars, msgVars, verifyVars,
                       IsLeader, IsFollower, IsMyLearner, IsMyLeader
<1>4. PrimaryIntegrity /\ [Next]_vars => PrimaryIntegrity'
  BY <1>2, <1>3
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>4, PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF ZooKeeper/Zab_PrimaryIntegrity.tla
====
